new_page.title: Cloverdale Office Space for Sale
new_page.description: Office space for sale in Cloverdale: office buildings and strata units on the MLS®, with recent office sales and the zones that allow offices.

faq_heading: Cloverdale Office Space for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Office space for sale in Cloverdale: office buildings and office strata units listed on the MLS®. For sale only; space for lease is not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.

items.t: The City’s business overview counts 617 office jobs in the Cloverdale industrial area; the City does not publish a separate office district for Cloverdale. ([City of Surrey, Cloverdale Industrial Area](https://www.surrey.ca/sites/default/files/media/documents/CloverdaleIndustrialArea.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: In the second quarter of 2026, 7 of the 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey were office properties, against 46 across the Lower Mainland. Commercial Edge reports Surrey as one city, so the figure covers all of Surrey, not only Cloverdale.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
City of Surrey zones that allow office uses

Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. These are municipal zones, so some apply to parts of Surrey outside Cloverdale. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.

items.t: O2 City Centre Office Employment Zone

faq.q: How many office properties sold in Surrey recently?
faq.a: 7 in the second quarter of 2026, out of 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey (GVR Commercial Edge).
